## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PlatformModule — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/PlatformModule.kt (provideHealthConnectClient)

## Trigger

MainActivity's field injection of `healthConnectClient`, run by Hilt
at activity creation (onCreate) — observed

## Today

`PlatformModule.provideHealthConnectClient` calls
`HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)` unconditionally, with no
prior call to `HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context)`.
`MainActivity` declares `healthConnectClient` as a non-null
`lateinit var`, injected by Hilt before `onCreate`'s body runs. On a
device without Health Connect installed, `getOrCreate` raises, and
the app crashes before any screen renders — the profile screen never
gets the chance to react.

Two consumers hold the client as a non-null dependency and would
still break once `provideHealthConnectClient` stops crashing and
starts returning an absent client instead:

- `HrHistoryReaderImpl` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/health/HrHistoryReaderImpl.kt)
  takes a non-null `HealthConnectClient` in its constructor;
  `PlatformModule.provideHrHistoryReader` binds it straight from the
  client the graph provides, with no path for "no client".
- `ActivityBoundHrPermissionHost.bind` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/health/permission/ActivityBoundHrPermissionHost.kt)
  takes a non-null `HealthConnectClient` parameter; `MainActivity`
  calls `hrPermissionHost.bind(healthConnectClient, hrPermissionLauncher)`
  unconditionally, in `onCreate`.

`ProfileUiState` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileUiState.kt)
carries no field distinguishing "heart-rate history unavailable"
from "not yet derived" — `hrMaxBpm` stays null and `zoneRows` stays
empty either way, with no label naming the reason.

## Expected

`provideHealthConnectClient` calls `HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context)`
first and only calls `getOrCreate` when it reports the SDK
available; when it does not, no client is built and nothing raises.

`MainActivity`'s injected client becomes optional, and it skips
`hrPermissionHost.bind(...)` when absent — `ActivityBoundHrPermissionHost`
already reports "not granted" with no delegate bound, so nothing
downstream needs to change to accommodate that skip.

`HrHistoryReaderImpl`'s binding accommodates an absent client — the
history reader reports no readings rather than the graph failing to
construct it.

`ProfileViewModel`/`ProfileUiState` gain a way to say the heart-rate
history is unavailable — distinct from a permission simply not yet
granted — and `ProfileScreen` renders that state as text instead of
silently leaving the heart-rate zones hidden with no explanation.
